name: @nexus/ai-gateway
description: In-repo runtime LLM call gateway (5-layer default-deny). Mirrors @nexus/ott-gateway pattern: skill-scoped authz, token budget, circuit breaker, append-only audit. Phase 1: anthropic-api adapter only.

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/authz && cp authz/policies.json dist/authz/policies.json && mkdir -p dist/config && cp config/proxy.json dist/config/proxy.json
